title: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ if allowed to return as Nvidia CEO
lede: In a statement posted on X, Jensen Huang said he would come back as Nvidia CEO if the board decided it was best for the company, while admitting serious mistakes in his personal life.

points: Huang resigned after reports of several affairs, one with a former Megaspeed executive suspected of working with Chinese intelligence.
He says he will cooperate with the board's independent investigation and owns his mistakes.
An open letter asking for his return drew more than 10,000 current and former Nvidia employees, plus Elon Musk, Amjad Masad and Travis Kalanick.
A board source told the Washington Post there are no plans to reinstate him, and lawmakers have pushed back hard.
Huang is due to testify before Congress on December 1, as Nvidia's chip exports face scrutiny.
